scope: Complete English and Chinese final Markdown scientific-text review, numerical consistency with saved source tables/audits, inferential scope, known-upstream attribution, candidate universes, assembly completeness and Tables 1/2. No manuscript source was edited.

checks.details: Both texts credit the known PR #261 correction merged on 2026-09-09, specify its fixed commit and exact agreement on 22 raw networks, and distinguish isolated aggregation from a full newer-release run. No novel-bug discovery claim remains.

Joint 200-allocation results are distinguished from 20 discovery and 10 validation conditional allocations, including the validation P floor of 0.10. Dynamic-gate P=0.005 and six-test Holm P=0.030 match tables. Fixed-family and gap-family conclusions remain separately limited; no sensitivity P values are borrowed from the raw null. The 24-test gap-family minimum Holm P=0.12 was also verified.

All 8 rows in each language match source candidate counts, concordant counts, complete and nonzero denominators, percentages and rounded correlations. Zero RRA effects are distinguished from missing expression.

The 17-library common set is 99 candidates: original-pair custom agreement 80/99; third comparisons 53/99 and 58/99. Separately eligible 223/445-edge comparisons are not mixed with this denominator. No third-cohort P values or individually verified mice-per-library claims are introduced; tissue, assay and platform differences are not given a causal attribution.

All 6 raw-to-corrected correlation pairs match the fixed 187/174 sets. Model results retain 10 default converged fits plus the sole 637-iteration extension, pooled-cell contamination interpretation, positive corrected totals, fractional float64 counts, and numerical-only source selection. >=1 is a sensitivity threshold, not evidence of absent expression; >0 retention and model subtraction do not validate cellular origin.

Ambient methods/results/discussion/caption and third methods/results/caption each occur exactly once in both final texts. No missing main section, duplicated long paragraph, unresolved citation key or template placeholder was found.

The five source rows retain distinct sample units: original animal libraries, third author-reported biological replicates, six paired sorted pools, and five spatial sections. Original QC totals 58,333/57,022, third 116,308 nuclei and spatial 11,969 spots match source summaries.

Named sorted effects and barrier-gene directions match source tables. Sorted pools, contralateral controls, pointwise intervals and mixed spatial spots remain supplementary context. Conclusions are limited to the original-pair expression advantage, known aggregation correction and weaker third-cohort transfer, without establishing cellular communication or barrier mechanisms.

limitations: This is a final-text consistency review against completed local evidence, not an independent rerun of raw sequencing analyses or mechanistic validation.
DOCX/PDF visual appearance and public archive/submission readiness are outside this record.
